spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile standing on a small patch of dirt and gravel against a plain light background. It has the overall body shape, proportions and posture of a stocky horse, with a large barrel-shaped trunk supported by four sturdy legs. The head, neck, legs and tail are covered in shaggy brown hair and fur, while the central trunk from behind the shoulders to the hips is covered in smooth, bare-looking skin that is dark gray on the back fading to pale cream on the belly and is densely covered with small raised white dots. The head is horse-like with an elongated muzzle, the neck is thick and arched, the mane is short and bristly, and the tail is long and hairy. All four feet end in hooves.

meta_spark.description: A stocky four-legged animal standing in side profile facing right, with the head, neck, legs and tail of a brown furry horse and a large rounded barrel-like torso. The head has a long face, the neck is thick with a short upright mane, the legs are sturdy and furry ending in hooves, and the long shaggy tail hangs at the rear. The torso is gray-dark on the back fading to pale cream on the belly and is densely covered in small pale speckles. The animal stands on a small patch of stony ground on a plain light background.
